confirmedFacts: Case commenced on 2026-11-12 by filing Summons and Verified Complaint.
Plaintiff: Jane Doe as Parent and Natural Guardian of A.D., an Infant.
Defendants: Jordan Smith, M.D. and Jordan Smith, M.D., P.C.
Plaintiff counsel: Hudson River Trial Law PLLC by Alex Morgan, Esq.
Defense counsel: Harbor Defense & Medical Liability LLP by Taylor Reed, Esq.
Nature of suit: medical malpractice - prenatal, delivery, newborn, and pediatric care.
Index Number: 900001/2026.
Venue: Supreme Court, Queens County, Medical Malpractice Part, Hon. Tracy Catapano-Fox.
Plaintiff filed Notice of Commencement of Action for Personal Injuries pursuant to CPLR 306-c on 2026-11-12.
Summons and complaint are referenced as initiating papers.
Defendants filed Verified Answer on 2026-12-03, denying liability and asserting affirmative defenses.
Issue joined as of 2026-12-03.
Defense counsel appears for both defendants.
Defendants served Demand for Bill of Particulars on 2026-12-03, demanding a verified bill of particulars within 30 days after service.
Defendants served a Notice to Take Deposition Upon Oral Examination for plaintiff, setting a proposed deposition date of April 30, 2027.
Defendants served Demand for Authorizations on 2026-12-03, demanding HIPAA-compliant authorizations for various records pursuant to CPLR 3120.

Defendants served Demand for Statements and Photographs on 2026-12-03, demanding production of statements, photographs, recordings, reports, and related materials within 14 days after receipt, pursuant to CPLR 3101.
Defendants served Demand Pursuant to Medicare, Medicaid and SCHIP Extension Act on 2026-12-03, demanding lien/benefit information within 20 days.
Plaintiff filed Notice of Medical Malpractice Action on 2027-02-28 (NYSCEF Doc. No. 9) pursuant to CPLR 3406(a) and 22 NYCRR 202.56(a).
Request for Judicial Intervention (RJI) filed on 2027-02-28 for medical, dental or podiatric malpractice case.
RJI identifies case as tort / medical, dental or podiatric malpractice matter.
RJI places case into Queens Medical, Dental and Podiatric Malpractice Part workflow.
RJI triggers monitoring for preliminary conference scheduling or order issuance.
